title.kn: ಜಾಗತೀಕರಣ, ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶ್ವ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ

heading.en: Your call is answered in Bengaluru

hook.en: A customer in London calls her bank and is helped by someone in Bengaluru. How did the world become one market like this?
hook.kn: ಲಂಡನ್‌ನ ಗ್ರಾಹಕಿ ತನ್ನ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಜಗತ್ತು ಹೀಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಹೇಗಾಯಿತು?

objectives.en: Describe the role of the WTO

narration.en: A customer in London calls her bank and is helped by someone in Bengaluru. How did the world become one market like this?
narration.kn: ಲಂಡನ್‌ನ ಗ್ರಾಹಕಿ ತನ್ನ ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಜಗತ್ತು ಹೀಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ಮಾರುಕಟ್ಟೆ ಹೇಗಾಯಿತು?

body.en: Globalisation is the integration of the economy of a country with the world economy, creating greater interdependence. Outsourcing is a major outcome: a company hires regular services from an external source, often from other countries, that it earlier provided itself. With modern IT, services such as call centres, record keeping, accountancy, banking services, music recording and medical transcription are outsourced to India because of low wages and skilled manpower.
body.kn: ಜಾಗತೀಕರಣ ಎಂದರೆ ದೇಶದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ವ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸುವುದು. ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಂಪನಿ ತಾನೇ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊರಗಿನ, ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ವಿದೇಶಿ ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು. ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೇತನ ಮತ್ತು ಕುಶಲ ಮಾನವ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಭಾರತ ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆಯ ತಾಣವಾಗಿದೆ.

points.en: Low wage rates and skilled, English-speaking workers
IT and telecom made it possible

narration.en: Globalisation is the integration of the economy of a country with the world economy, creating greater interdependence. Outsourcing is a major outcome: a company hires regular services from an external source, often from other countries, that it earlier provided itself. With modern IT, services such as call centres, record keeping, accountancy, banking services, music recording and medical transcription are outsourced to India because of low wages and skilled manpower.
narration.kn: ಜಾಗತೀಕರಣ ಎಂದರೆ ದೇಶದ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯನ್ನು ವಿಶ್ವ ಆರ್ಥಿಕತೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಸಂಯೋಜಿಸುವುದು. ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಕಂಪನಿ ತಾನೇ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ ಸೇವೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊರಗಿನ, ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ವಿದೇಶಿ ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಪಡೆಯುವುದು. ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೇತನ ಮತ್ತು ಕುಶಲ ಮಾನವ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲದಿಂದ ಭಾರತ ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆಯ ತಾಣವಾಗಿದೆ.

body.en: The WTO was founded in 1995 as the successor to the General Agreement on Trade and Tariffs (GATT), which was set up in 1948. It aims at a rule-based trading system in which no country can place arbitrary restrictions on trade. It covers trade in goods and services, removes tariff and non-tariff barriers, and India is a founder member.
body.kn: ವಿಶ್ವ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ (ಡಬ್ಲ್ಯುಟಿಒ) 1995ರಲ್ಲಿ, 1948ರ ಗ್ಯಾಟ್‌ನ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯಾಯಿತು. ಯಾವ ದೇಶವೂ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಬಂದಂತೆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧ ಹೇರದ ನಿಯಮಾಧಾರಿತ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಇದರ ಗುರಿ.

narration.en: The WTO was founded in 1995 as the successor to the General Agreement on Trade and Tariffs (GATT), which was set up in 1948. It aims at a rule-based trading system in which no country can place arbitrary restrictions on trade. It covers trade in goods and services, removes tariff and non-tariff barriers, and India is a founder member.

problem.en: A UK firm pays £20 an hour for data entry at home. An Indian BPO does the same work for £6 an hour. For 10,000 hours of work, how much does the firm save by outsourcing?

answer.en: £1,40,000 saved: low cost with skilled manpower makes India an outsourcing destination.

points.en: Globalisation integrates the national economy with the world economy.

points.en: Outsourcing grew in India because of skilled, low-wage workers and IT.
points.kn: ಕುಶಲ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ವೇತನದ ಕಾರ್ಮಿಕರು ಮತ್ತು ಐಟಿಯಿಂದ ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಗುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು.

points.en: The WTO (1995) replaced GATT (1948) to build a rule-based trading system.
